attrs.name: Optimal Range
attrs.note: Stretches the very short effective range just enough to matter.

talents.d: Any weapon. +3% weapon damage for every 10% of ammo missing from the magazine.
talents.w: Core DPS talent. Best on high-capacity LMGs, ARs and rifles.

talents.d: Any weapon. Killing with a critical hit grants +40% critical hit damage for 10s.
talents.w: Pure crit-DPS gain. Pairs with any high-CHC build — the Striker/St. Elmo's staple.

talents.d: Any weapon. +2% weapon damage for every 5m of distance to the target.
talents.w: Strong AR / rifle DPS for ranged solo play. Easy uptime at distance.

talents.d: Any weapon. Body shots stack bonus headshot damage onto your next headshot (up to 3 stacks).
talents.w: Big for headshot builds — especially on full-auto where heads are hard to land. Off-build for pure crit.

talents.d: Any weapon. +10% critical hit damage for every 0.5s of continuous fire, stacks up to 5.
talents.w: Strong sustained crit-damage on automatics. Wants high crit chance to pay off.

talents.d: Any weapon. Critical hits stack a +4% reload-speed bonus (max 40%).
talents.w: Utility that keeps LMGs/ARs firing. Pairs naturally with Killer/crit builds.

talents.d: Shotguns. Three consecutive kills refill the mag and grant +40% weapon damage for 10s.
talents.w: Shotgun-build payoff; needs the kill streak to fire.

talents.d: Shotguns. Each reload stacks +1% weapon damage for 10s (up to 25).
talents.w: Ramp-up shotgun talent. Slow to build, shotgun-only.

talents.d: Any weapon. Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage; using a skill (or hitting with one) grants +15% weapon damage.
talents.w: Excellent on hybrid / skill-DPS builds. Dead weight on a pure red build.

talents.d: Any weapon. +15% weapon damage to pulsed enemies; after 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.
talents.w: Pulse-status synergy (pairs with Spotter / skill builds). Off-build for crit.

talents.d: Any weapon. Killing a status-afflicted enemy grants you and allies in 15m +15% crit chance & crit damage for 20s.
talents.w: Excellent in groups or status builds. Solo it still buffs you, but needs a status source.

talents.d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to bleeding enemies; applies bleed after 4 kills.
talents.w: Status-build synergy. Off a crit build it's filler.

talents.d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to burning enemies; applies burn after 4 kills.
talents.w: Good with fire/skill (incendiary) builds. Otherwise skip.

talents.d: Any weapon. +20% weapon damage to blinded enemies; applies blind after 4 kills.
talents.w: Niche — needs a blind source or the self-apply to matter.

talents.d: Any weapon. Headshots grant +20% skill damage for 15s.
talents.w: Skill-build only. Dead on a weapon-damage build.

talents.d: Any weapon. Headshots boost the damage & duration of your next status effect (+50%).
talents.w: Niche status / skill sustain.

talents.d: Any weapon. Headshots grant +30% skill repair for 15s.
talents.w: Healer / support skill builds only.

talents.d: Any weapon. Kills repair 10% armour over 5s; headshot kills repair an extra 10%.
talents.w: Handy survivability while you're gearing solo — usually dropped at full endgame DPS.

talents.d: Any weapon. Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s (stacks to 3); kills at tier 6 grant Overcharge.
talents.w: Strong on skill-tier builds — irrelevant to weapon-damage builds.

talents.d: Any weapon. Grenade damage marks targets; marked enemies take +30% armour damage and move slower.
talents.w: Niche armour-shred utility. Not a general DPS pick.

talents.d: Any weapon. Hits stack +1% accuracy & stability; at 100 stacks consumes them to refill the mag.
talents.w: Light utility, mostly for hard-to-control weapons. Not a damage pick.

talents.d: All weapons. Killing a target within 7m grants +30% weapon damage for 10s.
talents.w: Risky at high difficulty; aggressive close-range only.
